metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully configured fit-to-one-page scaling and exported PDF. Trajectory demonstrated ability to interact with Format menus and File export dialogs.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can rename sheet tabs, configure page scaling, save files, and export to PDF.
metadata.explanation: Chains the source task with a sheet-rename objective. Evaluator gives 0.33 for renaming Sheet1 to 'Attendance' (verified from saved xlsx), 0.34 for fit-to-one-page page scaling (ws.sheet_properties.pageSetUpPr.fitToPage == True), and 0.33 for PDF exported to /home/user. Initial state has sheet name 'Sheet1', no fit-to-page scaling, and no PDF, so initial score is 0.0. [Fixed: added page_fit check using openpyxl ws.sheet_properties.pageSetUpPr.fitToPage; updated scoring to 0.33/0.34/0.33 split across sheet rename, page scaling, and PDF export]
metadata.task_rationale: Adds a compatible spreadsheet operation (sheet rename) to the demonstrated PDF export skill, testing two verifiable sub-goals with partial credit.

scoring_breakdown.sheet_renamed: 0.33 - Sheet1 renamed to 'Attendance' in saved xlsx
scoring_breakdown.page_fit: 0.34 - ws.sheet_properties.pageSetUpPr.fitToPage == True (fit print range(s) on one page)

fix_history: Fix 1: Added page_fit check in getter using openpyxl ws.sheet_properties.pageSetUpPr.fitToPage to verify fit-to-one-page scaling was set
Fix 2: Updated metric scoring from 0.5/0.5 to 0.33/0.34/0.33 split for sheet rename / page scaling / PDF export
Fix 3: Added page_fit: true to evaluator expected.rules so metric can validate the scaling requirement
Fix 4: Updated scoring_breakdown and explanation to document three-way partial credit

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the saved xlsx and extracts the first sheet name using openpyxl, properly verifying the sheet rename to 'Attendance'.
Getter correctly checks for the existence of /home/user/Resize_Cells_Fit_Page.pdf, verifying the PDF export to the home directory.
Getter now includes page scaling check via ws.sheet_properties.pageSetUpPr.fitToPage, covering the previously missing 'resize to fit one page' requirement.
Metric awards 0.33 + 0.34 + 0.33 = 1.0 partial credit across all three sub-goals (sheet rename, page fit, PDF export), matching the scoring_breakdown and expected rules.
Negative control resistance is sound: initial state has sheet name 'Sheet1', no fit-to-page scaling, and no PDF, so initial score is 0.0.

Minor caveat: fitToPage=True confirms fit-to-page mode is active but does not strictly verify the target is exactly 1 page (vs. e.g. 2 pages). However, the LibreOffice 'Fit print range(s) on number of pages=1' workflow reliably sets this flag, making it a sound semantic proxy.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optional: for stricter verification of 'one page', also check ws.page_setup.fitToHeight == 1 and ws.page_setup.fitToWidth == 0 (or 1) in addition to fitToPage=True.
